concrete_scene.heading: Worked negative result: when the compact core made the packet larger
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: The frozen deterministic KERC compiler and runtime campaign on its authored bilingual corpus
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Test whether complete Kernel packets preserved held-out task quality while reducing total description size against matched surface and simple-handle representations.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: All compared cores tied at 0.5 held-out quality, complete Kernel packets averaged 714.0 bytes, and the best simple representation averaged 73.25 bytes; one of twenty attacks escaped.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The preregistered broad efficiency claim failed for the frozen implementation, while a competence audit showed that the run could not refute the entire architecture family.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: A future competent KERC implementation campaign owns the missing training class, stronger cores, verifier separation, residual de-duplication, calibrated energy, and cross-language transfer.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The result is an N1 inadequate-implementation negative result with real bounded observations; it refutes the frozen broad claim, not every learned compiler, residual design, corpus, model, or language.

worked_trace.heading: Worked negative result: when the compact core made the packet larger
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The frozen deterministic KERC proxy failed its broad matched total-system efficiency claim and was implementation-inadequate; other KERC implementations and the wider compact-generative architecture remain untested.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: A naive response would hide the failure or declare the whole idea dead. Residual honesty retains the 714.0-versus-73.25 observation, refutes the frozen claim, and limits the causal conclusion to an inadequate implementation.
readable_claim: A representation is compact only after reconstruction, verification, repair, fallback, and residual costs are counted beside its seed or payload.
normative_rule: Compare the complete transmitted and reconstructed system against strong literal and standard-compression baselines under the same quality contract. If the compact route loses, preserve the negative result, diagnose implementation competence, and fall back without hiding the unpaid burden.

formal_binding.anchor: compact representation should be admitted only

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene distinguishes the frozen broad-claim refutation from the later finding that the tested implementation was inadequate.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Separate codec, semantic utility, verifier independence, fallback, energy, corpus, language, and transfer limitations remain in the campaign and evidence-reconciliation surfaces.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The four-step disposition list remains because it teaches negative-result handling; full baseline, ablation, attack, and mutation inventories stay in the campaign reports.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The reader claim and operational rule replace no exact formal terms but provide a short route into the retained comprehensive core claim.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The central scope boundary is stated once after the result and competence audit; distinct campaign limitations remain where they are actionable.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The worked result uses prose and a short decision sequence rather than adding another protocol inventory.

non_claims: The KERC result does not refute every compact-generative or learned-compiler design.
The trace does not establish a useful codec, semantic representation, or deployed fallback.
The editorial revision does not move chapter-core support or release state.
